title: Freeze on new late-night liquor licences lifted (Victoria)
summary: A freeze on new liquor licences trading after 1 am in Melbourne, Yarra, Port Phillip and Stonnington, first introduced in 2008, ended for applications made on or after 1 July 2023 under new risk-based guidelines.

instruments.title: Decision-making guidelines under s 172U(4) of the Liquor Control Reform Act 1998

direction_rationale: Lifting a freeze on new late-night licences removes a barrier to entry for late-trading venues in inner Melbourne.
comparison: Other Victorian council areas; the 2008 start of the freeze is the mirror-image change (date not confirmed)

verified.notes: Read in the Victoria Government Gazette (S356, 30 June 2023).
